name: 1.1 CT packages structure
description: Show the SDTM CT catalogue with its packages codelists and terms
query:
MATCH p=(:CTPackage)<-[:CONTAINS_PACKAGE]-(cat:CTCatalogue WHERE cat.name="SDTM CT")-[:HAS_CODELIST]->(:CTCodelistRoot)-[:HAS_TERM]->(:CTCodelistTerm)-[:HAS_TERM_ROOT]->(:CTTermRoot)
RETURN p LIMIT 20

name: 1.2 Libraries with CT codelists
description: List all libraries that contain at least one CT codelist
query: MATCH (n:Library) WHERE EXISTS { (n)-->(:CTCodelistRoot) } RETURN n.name AS library

name: 1.3 CT Term Name and Attributes
description: Show the split between Name (sponsor override) and Attributes (CDISC issuer) nodes for CT terms
query:
MATCH (n:Library WHERE n.name="CDISC")-[:CONTAINS_CODELIST]->(c)-[:HAS_TERM]->(:CTCodelistTerm)-[:HAS_TERM_ROOT]->(t:CTTermRoot)-->()-[:LATEST]->(nv:CTTermNameValue)
MATCH (t:CTTermRoot)-->()-[:LATEST]->(av:CTTermAttributesValue)
MATCH (c)-->()-[:LATEST]->(cnv:CTCodelistNameValue)
RETURN n.name AS library, cnv.name AS codelist, properties(nv) AS name, properties(av) AS attributes
LIMIT 5

name: 1.4 Sponsor name overrides
description: Find terms where the sponsor name differs from the CDISC preferred term
query:
MATCH (n:Library WHERE n.name="CDISC")-[:CONTAINS_CODELIST]->(c)-[:HAS_TERM]->(:CTCodelistTerm)-[:HAS_TERM_ROOT]->(t:CTTermRoot)-->()-[:LATEST]->(nv:CTTermNameValue)
MATCH (t:CTTermRoot)-->()-[:LATEST]->(av:CTTermAttributesValue)
WITH DISTINCT nv.name AS sponsor_name, av.preferred_term AS CDISC_name
WHERE sponsor_name <> CDISC_name
RETURN sponsor_name, CDISC_name
LIMIT 20

name: 2.1 Libraries with Dictionary codelists
description: List all libraries that contain at least one dictionary codelist
query: MATCH (n:Library) WHERE EXISTS { (n)-->(:DictionaryCodelistRoot) } RETURN n.name AS library

name: 2.2 SNOMED dictionary terms
description: Browse SNOMED codelists and terms with their properties — unlike CT terms there is no Name/Attributes split
query:
MATCH (n:Library WHERE n.name="SNOMED")-[:CONTAINS_DICTIONARY_CODELIST]->(c)-[:HAS_TERM]->(t:DictionaryTermRoot)-[:LATEST]->(v:DictionaryTermValue)
MATCH (c)-[:LATEST]->(cv:DictionaryCodelistValue)
RETURN n.name AS library, cv.name AS codelist, properties(v) AS term
LIMIT 5

name: 3.1 Template types in the database
description: List all template node label types currently stored in the database
query:
MATCH (n) WITH DISTINCT labels(n) AS labels
UNWIND labels AS label
WITH label WHERE label CONTAINS "Template" AND label CONTAINS "Root" AND NOT label CONTAINS "Parameter" AND NOT label CONTAINS "Odm"
RETURN DISTINCT label ORDER BY label

name: 3.2 Criteria template examples
description: Show criteria templates with their parameters and CT term type — Root holds immutable relationships while Value nodes hold the text
query:
MATCH p=(l:Library)-->(n:CriteriaTemplateRoot)-->(:TemplateParameter)
WITH p LIMIT 5
MATCH subpath=(type:CTTermRoot)<-[:HAS_TYPE]-(n)-[:HAS_VERSION]->(version)
RETURN p, subpath

name: 3.3 Template parameters
description: List all available template parameter types

name: 3.4 Parameter value types
description: Show which node types can be used as values for each template parameter type
query:
MATCH (n:TemplateParameter)-[:HAS_VALUE]->(m)
WITH n.name AS parameterType, labels(m) AS labels
UNWIND labels AS label
WITH parameterType, label WHERE NOT label IN ["TemplateParameterValueRoot", "ConceptRoot", "FindingRoot", "ActivityInstanceRoot", "SnomedTermRoot", "SimpleConceptRoot"]
RETURN DISTINCT parameterType, collect(DISTINCT label) AS labels

name: 3.5 Study objective from template
description: Show how a study objective is derived from a template with injected parameter values and linked to a StudySelection for auditing
query:
MATCH p=(:ObjectiveTemplateValue)<-[:LATEST]-(:ObjectiveTemplateRoot)-->(:ObjectiveRoot)-[:LATEST]->(v:ObjectiveValue)-[:OV_USES_VALUE]->()-[:LATEST]->()
MATCH subpath=(v)<--(:StudySelection)<--(:StudyValue)
RETURN p, subpath LIMIT 1

name: 4.1 Root-Value structure
description: Show the Root-Value versioning pattern — Root holds immutable properties (uid) while Value nodes hold properties that can change over time (name)

name: 4.2 Immutable relationships on Root
description: Show that Library and Parameters are attached to the Root node — a template always belongs to the same library and its parameters never change

name: 4.3 Versioned relationships on Value
description: Show that a specific StudyValue selects a specific ObjectiveValue — both are versioned so only compatible versions are linked

name: 4.4 HAS_VERSION relationship properties
description: Inspect the properties of a HAS_VERSION relationship: status (Draft/Final/Retired) start_date end_date change_description user_initials version
query:
MATCH ()-[rel:HAS_VERSION]-()
WHERE rel.end_date IS NOT NULL
RETURN properties(rel) LIMIT 1

name: 4.5 Convenience relationships between Root and Value
description: List all relationship types that exist between a Root and its Value nodes besides HAS_VERSION — includes LATEST and LATEST_DRAFT/FINAL/RETIRED shortcuts
query:
MATCH (a)-[rel:HAS_VERSION]-(b)
MATCH (a)-[other_rel]-(b)
WHERE NOT other_rel:HAS_VERSION
RETURN DISTINCT type(other_rel)
